name: Absolute set
desc: The Absolute set is a set of armour and equipment themed around the Cult of the Absolute . They provide bonuses to characters who bear the Brand of the Absolute , except for the Vision of the Absolute .

name: Acid set
desc: The Acid set is a set of equipment that helps the user do Acid damage. Syngerizes with items from the Elemental set , which are not duplicated here. It consists of the following pieces:

name: Adamantine set
desc: The Adamantine set is a set of armour and equipment from the Adamantine Forge (location) and related to the Adamantine Forge (quest) .

name: Bard set
desc: The Bard set includes items that interact with Bard mechanics.

name: Bhaalist set

name: Blackguard set
desc: The Blackguard equipment is a set of armour themed around Oathbreaker Paladins . See also Paladin set .

name: Bonespike set
desc: Bonespike is a proper set of equipment pieces which generally provide their user benefits while raging , or provide new abilities or passives when worn. They have no proficiency requirements.

name: Cantrip set
desc: The Cantrip set enhances damaging cantrips or grants access to them. Synergizes with items from the Elemental set and Sparkstruck set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Ceremonial set

name: Charisma set
desc: The Charisma set includes items that increase Charisma . The abilities page explains the priority by which ability score increases are applied.

name: Cleric set
desc: The Cleric set includes items which interact with Cleric mechanics, are only obtainable by clerics, or inflict the Turned condition.

name: Cold set
desc: The Frost set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal Cold damage and inflict the conditions Wet , Chilled , Encrusted with Frost or Frozen . Syngerizes with items from the Elemental set , which are not duplica...

name: Constitution set
desc: The Constitution set includes items that increase Constitution . Items listed below do not have synergy amongst themselves or other items. The abilities page explains the priority by which ability score increases are...

name: Dark Justiciar set
desc: The Dark Justiciar equipment is a set of armour themed after Shar's Dark Justiciars . Their bonuses revolve around being obscured .

name: Dexterity set
desc: The Dexterity set includes items that increase Dexterity . Items listed below do not have synergy amongst themselves or other items. The abilities page explains the priority by which ability score increases are applied.

name: Druid set
desc: The Druid set includes items that interact with Druid mechanics or enhance shapeshifting and disguise.

name: Drunk set
desc: The Drunk set includes items that interact with Alcohol mechanics.

name: Elemental set

name: Fighter set
desc: The Fighter set includes items that interact with Fighter mechanics.

name: Fire set
desc: The Fire Set is a set of equipment that deals Fire damage and inflicts the Burning condition. Synergizes with items from the Heat Set , Helldusk Set , and Elemental set , which are not duplicated here. It consists of...

name: Force set
desc: The Force set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal Force damage and gain the Force Conduit condition. The set consists of the following pieces:

desc: The Gish (hybrid) set comprises of equipment that benefits both spellcasters and martial characters. Items that boost Initiative , Critical hit , off-hand attacks , all attack rolls (thereby including the Sparkstruck...

name: Githyanki set
desc: The following items are related to the Githyanki in terms of game mechanics, or thematically.

name: Healing set
desc: The Healing set is a set of equipment that increases the effects of healing , offers bonuses when you heal/are healed, and provides ways to heal allies or grant them temporary hit points . Interacts with the Self-Heal...

name: Heat set
desc: The Heat Set is a set of equipment that helps the user with the Heat condition. Synergizes with items from the Fire set , which are not duplicated here. The set consists of the following pieces :

name: Helldusk set
desc: Helldusk armour is a set of equipment that revolves around resisting and dealing Fire damage. It is forged from Infernal Iron or Infernal Alloy .

name: Hiding set
desc: The Hiding Set is a set of equipment that helps enhances Hiding . Synergizes with items from the Dark Justiciar set and Obscured set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Kushigo set
desc: Kushigo is a set of equipment. Kushigo equipment generally boosts unarmed and unarmoured characters, such as those classed into Monk . See also Monk set , Soul set , Unarmed set , and List of features and items that i...

name: Lightning set
desc: The Lightning set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal or resist Lightning damage. It synergizes with items from the Sparkstruck set and Elemental set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Low HP set
desc: The Low HP set is a group of equipment that benefits from having a small number of hit points and includes items that damage the wielder to more easily reach those low HP values. The self-burn from the Heat Set also h...

name: Luminous set
desc: The Luminous set is a set of equipment that inflicts Radiating Orb when the wearer deals Radiant damage. Synergizes with items from the Radiant set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Modify Ability Score set
desc: The Modify Ability Score set includes items that increase an ability score by a specified amount, rather than setting the score to a fixed value. For the latter, see Set Ability Score set .

name: Monk set
desc: The Monk set includes items that interact with Monk mechanics and, in addition to the set listed below, includes the Kushigo set , Soul set , Unarmed set and Drunk set .

name: Necrotic set
desc: The Necrotic set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal or resist Necrotic damage. Synergizes with items from the Dark Justiciar Set , Helldusk Set and the Blackguard Set , which are not duplicated here. The s...

name: Obscured set
desc: The Obscured set is a set of equipment that primarily benefits from the wearer or their target being lightly or heavily obscured . Also includes items that grant magical darkvision and blind immunity as they enhance w...

name: Off-hand set
desc: The off-hand set contains equipment designed to enhance weapons in the off-hand slot.

name: Paladin set
desc: The Paladin set includes items that interact with Paladin mechanics. The Blackguard set is part of it, but its items are not reproduced here.

name: Poison set
desc: The Poison set is a set of equipment that helps the user do Poison damage or inflict Poisoned . It consists of the following pieces:

name: Psychic set
desc: The Psychic set is a set of equipment that deals or synergizes with Psychic damage and inflicts Mental Fatigue . The set consists of the following pieces:

name: Radiant set
desc: The Radiant set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal Radiant damage. Synergizes with items from the Luminous set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Reverberation set
desc: The Reverberation set is a set of equipment that applies or interacts with Reverberation . Synergizes with items from the Thunder set .

name: Self-Heal set
desc: The Self-Heal set is a set of equipment that focuses on healing and providing temporary hit points to the wearer. Some items also grant additional benefits when healed. Interacts with the Healing set , which is not du...

name: Set Ability Score set
desc: The Set Ability Score set includes items that increase an ability to a fixed score, rather than increasing the score with a specified value. For the latter, see Modify Ability Score set .

name: Sorcerer set
desc: The Sorcerer set includes items that interact with Sorcerer mechanics.

name: Soul set
desc: Soul is a set of equipment that primarily benefits those classed into Monk , with improvements to unarmed attacks. See also Kushigo set , Monk set , Unarmed set , and List of features and items that interact with unar...

name: Sparkstruck set
desc: The Sparkstruck set consists of of items which grant or interact with Lightning Charges and / or were invented by Yrre the Sparkstruck. Synergizes with items from the Lightning set , which are not duplicated here.

name: Strength set
desc: The Strength set includes items that increase Strength . With the exception of Devilfoil Masks, items listed below do not have synergy amongst themselves or other items.

name: Threatened set
desc: The Threatened set is a set of equipment that applies or interacts with Threatened . Synergises with Arcane Charge The set consists of the following pieces:

desc: The Thunder Set is a set of equipment that helps the user deal Thunder damage. Synergizes with items from the Reverberation set and Elemental set , which are not duplicated here. It consists of the following pieces :

name: Unarmed set
desc: The unarmed set enhances unarmed attacks. The Kushigo set and Soul set are part of this set, but they are not duplicated here. See also List of features and items that interact with unarmed strikes and Monk set .

name: Unwanted set
desc: The Unwanted Set is a set of masterwork armour. It consists of the following pieces:

name: Warlock set
desc: The Warlock set includes items that interact with Warlock mechanics.

name: Weave set
desc: The Weave Set is a set that boosts its wearer's spell-related rolls through Arcane Enchantment : Gain bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls . Previously worn by wizard Tenser and Edith Cluckle.

name: Wizard set
desc: The Wizard set includes items that interact with Wizard mechanics.

name: Wrath set
desc: The Wrath set is a set of equipment that generates Wrath , a stacking condition that grants up to +7 melee damage bonus.
